name: Librería ARETé
description: Montevideo bookstore selling new and used books online, including Uruguayan literature, history, law, children's and school and university textbooks. States shipping to all of Uruguay.
description_es: Librería de Montevideo que vende en línea libros nuevos y usados: literatura uruguaya, historia, derecho, infantiles y textos escolares y universitarios. Informa envíos a todo el Uruguay.

ships_to.notes: Store states shipping to all of Uruguay in 24 to 48 hours, same-day courier in Montevideo, free over a stated minimum

shopping_notes: WooCommerce store. Shipping and FAQ details are on the homepage, no separate shipping page.

sources.supports: shipping scope, delivery times, free-shipping threshold, books catalog and cart
